title: [Kev 7] Metal run, mechanism probes, docs
body:

- `docs/kev/` updates: README status table flips to implemented, architecture.md notes the Rust landing zones, mesh-plan.md links the crate.
- `MODEL_CARD`-equivalent local eval record committed for the admitted artifact.

## Acceptance

- Probe results documented in `docs/kev/` with exact commands.
- Every issue in the sequence closed with its verification noted.
